items.title: Tesla Cybercab to launch Sept. 3 as robotaxi bet ramps up
items.summary: Tesla will unveil the production Cybercab at a launch event in Austin, Texas, on Sept. 3. This comes as Tesla ramps up its self-driving efforts — key to the company's big growth plans.

items.title: Uber's Robotaxi Push Gains Pace in Dubai: Baidu's Vehicles Debut
items.summary: UBER expands its robotaxi push as fully driverless Apollo Go vehicles debut in Dubai, the first launch under its multi-year strategic partnership.

items.title: Dutch regulator fines Uber €824.99m over automated driver dismissals
items.summary: The Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens found that Uber relied on software to track driver conduct and customer feedback, leading to accounts being automatically suspended over suspected fraud and permanently shut down where ratings stayed low over time.

items.title: Why Tesla’s Nevada Robo-Taxi Approval Can’t Save the Stock
items.summary: The long-awaited scaling up of  Tesla’s  robo-taxi service might be close.  The Nevada Transportation Authority has approved autonomous vehicle applications for Tesla,  Alphabet’s  Waymo, and Aviari, an  Uber  platform.  Tesla will be allowed to deploy up to 5,000 robo-taxis over the coming 12 months.

items.title: Does Billionaire Bill Ackman Know Something Wall Street Doesn’t? He Invested in These 2 Stocks That Have Dropped 33% and 18% Over the Past Year
items.summary: Bill Ackman is shopping for great deals. Investors might want to follow suit.

items.title: Uber faces fine of nearly $1B over automated driver suspensions
items.summary: The Dutch Data Protection Authority is fining Uber €825 million in the second-largest penalty issued under Europe’s GDPR.

items.title: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square invests $1.1B in fintech giant
items.summary: Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square built a $1.1 billion new stake in the fintech heavyweight.

items.title: MarketBeat Week in Review – 08/17 - 08/21
items.summary: Stocks fell this week as Treasury bond buybacks, oil prices, and Walmart earnings weighed on markets, while Bitcoin rallied; MarketBeat analysts cover Moderna, NVIDIA, Meta, RTX, and more.
